text:
emma: Heads up - DataPulse renewal hitting next month. They say traffic + usage grew 3x. Customer asks for new commercial baseline and wants rates rebased; current commit is 200k tokens/mo at $0.0008/token. They propose 35% uplift to list but want the per-unit cut for higher commit tiers. Also security questionnaire still open (SLA + KMS). Can sales ops + deal desk advise? Link: https://redwood.app/contract/DP-456

josh: Thanks. Do we have current YTD overage and growth forecast? Need numbers before suggesting % uplift. Also share the exact SKUs they use (embeddings vs gen).

emma: They moved most volume to embeddings (~70%) and heavy reranking. Overage last quarter ~120k tokens. Forecast says 2.5-3x next 12 months. They prefer annual commit if we give a better unit price.

ashok: Proposal idea: two-legged offer — (A) 12-month moderate uplift with a 20% unit price decrease on embed tokens if commit increases 2x, (B) shorter 6-month pilot at higher unit rate with a clear path to rebaseline at 12m. This reduces risk for us. Example rate card snippet:```
Tier A: 200k-400k tokens/mo -> $0.0008/token
Tier B: 400k-800k tokens/mo -> $0.00065/token (requires 12m commit)
Overage: $0.00095/token
```

mia: From CS: much of the spike looks cacheable once we add prefix caching + optimized batch sizes. Recommend Redwood Optimize review before finalizing price. We can propose a 30-day POC (free credits) to show steady-state cost drop. Also we should include a success metric (p99 latency < 200ms) for the customer — they care about latency.

lina: Legal: if we change baseline, need to avoid retroactive pricing. Add a rebaseline clause: "pricing adjustments apply from next billing cycle after mutual acceptance" and a security milestone: provide completed security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence within 30 days or defaulted terms. Also flag any KMS/HSM add-ons for PO.

ken: Quick finance math: if we accept 0.00065 on 12m commit (avg 600k/month) ARR impact ~ $4.68M run-rate vs current ~ $1.92M; margin impact depends on cost-per-token but we can offset with minimum committed ARR and an annual prepay step. Suggest 10% uplift cap if no commit.

dealdeck-bot: Deal size > $500k ARR — requires Director approval and special-terms checklist. Add deal desk packet: /deals/DP-456 for review.

emma: Concrete ask to the group: can we sign off on a counter that is 25% uplift to list but paired with a 12-month 2x commit at the Tier B unit price, plus a 30-day Optimize POC and security delivery milestone? If so I'll schedule a call with the customer this week.

josh: I can draft the counter & deal-deck today. Recommend including an early-exit fee pro-rated for committed discounts and a 60-day notice clause for any rate changes.

ashok: +1 to early-exit fee. Also propose a small onboarding credit (one-time) instead of an ongoing discount to protect unit economics.

mia: I'll own the POC and the metrics dashboard. Schedule for next Tue? I'll add SRE runbook and acceptance criteria.

lina: I'll draft the contract language for the rebaseline and KMS clauses.

emma: Perfect — will combine into counteroffer: 25% uplift (customer-facing), 12m 2x commit to unlock embed price $0.00065, 30-day Optimize POC, security milestone 30 days, early-exit fee. I'll ping director for approval once deal deck is ready. Thanks all :raised_hands:
